nodes.name: Daily 9AM (Weekdays)
nodes.notes: Weekday-only trigger — cold-calling compliance ke liye weekend exclude by default. Calling-hours window ⚠️ INPUT NEEDED confirm karo (Supprting_files.txt §23: 'Calling hours' production-config item).

parameters.query:
SELECT * FROM clients_master
WHERE COALESCE(call_dnc, false) = false
  AND phone IS NOT NULL AND phone <> ''
  AND score IN ('Hot', 'Warm')
  AND status IN ('Qualified', 'Contacted', 'Replied', 'Nurtured')
  AND (last_call_at IS NULL OR last_call_at < now() - interval '3 days')
  AND COALESCE(call_attempts, 0) < 5
ORDER BY score, updated_at ASC
LIMIT 100;

nodes.name: Postgres - Fetch Callable Leads
nodes.notes: 4.2.1.1: clients_master.call_dnc = internal DNC flag (opt-outs, past 'do not call' requests logged by 4.2.2). '5 attempts' / '3 days' cadence ⚠️ INPUT NEEDED confirm — reasonable default rakha hai.

nodes.name: External DNC Registry Lookup (optional)
nodes.notes: ⚠️ INPUT NEEDED — NDNC_REGISTRY_API_URL: India's National DNC (TRAI/NDNC) registry check needs a subscribed API (e.g. via a telecom/SMS-gateway provider that offers NDNC lookup). Isko abhi DISABLED/bypass rakha hai (node ke aage IF me skip ho jata hai agar env var empty hai) — sirf internal clients_master.call_dnc column hi enforce ho raha hai jab tak ye external check wire na ho. Is node ko delete mat karo, sirf env var set karne se activate ho jayega.
